    About Me

    I am James D. Orag, a student journalist and layout artist from the Philippines with experience in school publication, graphic design, and social media content creation. Through several years of campus journalism, I have developed my skills in layout design, visual communication, publication production, and digital storytelling. I am passionate about creating meaningful visual content that communicates stories and information effectively.
